children: Shell (SHEL) nearly doubled adjusted earnings year over year in Q3, reaching their highest since 2022, on stronger refining margins, higher realized LNG prices and increased Integrated Gas volumes.
Shell agreed to sell its 16.67% North West Shelf LNG stake and related assets to XRG for $1.45 billion plus a milestone payment. The deal is expected to close in 2027, subject to approvals.
Shell Plc Sponsored ADR (SHEL) is in discussions about selling its chemicals assets. CEO Wael Sawan said the assets are good but that Shell is not their natural owner.
Shell (SHEL) repurchased shares for cancellation on Nov. 2 under its buyback, announced Oct. 29. BNP Paribas and Natixis manage on- and off-market trades through Jan. 29, 2027.
Shell chemicals chief Emma Lewis will join BP on Jan. 4, 2027, to lead its downstream business. Shell said she guided its global chemicals unit through major change.
